title: Gate implementation on answered requirement survey to prevent scope drift
goal: Under KainBain task 0f0213b7-25f6-4930-8470-a73dc0611529 the requirement survey answers (docs/tasks/0f0213b7-25f6-4930-8470-a73dc0611529/SURVEY.md) landed after implementation had already started following the plan frontend-only default, and the late survey chose Whole project coverage while the shipped guardrail covers only the frontend package (acceptable per the ticket wording of at least the frontend package, with api/root left as an unwired --package flag and no follow-up recorded at the time). Prevent repeats structurally in the KainBain pipeline: do not let the Plan/implementation stages proceed on unanswered surveys by silently adopting defaults; either block until the survey is answered or require an explicit recorded scope-divergence decision when late answers contradict shipped scope. Acceptance: a task whose survey is unanswered cannot reach implementation on defaulted answers without an explicit recorded decision.
